newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR WALES V BELGIUM WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR WALES V BELGIUM WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup group seven qualifier between Wales and Belgium on Saturday:
Wales: 1-Neville Southall; 2-Clayton Blackmore, 3-Mark Pembridge, 4-Vinnie Jones, 5-Kit Symons, 6-Robert Page, 7-Barry Horne, 8-Gary Speed, 9-Dean Saunders, 10-Mark Hughes, 11-Ryan Giggs.

Belgium - 1-Filip De Wilde; -Bertrand Crasson, 3-Bart de Roover, 4-Eric Van Meir, 5-Rudi Smidts, 6-Franky Van der Elst, 7-Lorenzo Staelens, 8-Luis Oliveira-Barroso, 9-Lokonda M'Penza, 10-Dominique Lemoine, 11-Nico Van Kerckhoven.
